scope: Isolated SM-Status exclusion on combined ECUR INITIAL
boundaries: The INITIAL source fixture adds one SM-Status with payload 00. An isolated extra status can contain any octets, including empty and NUL.

5008 quotes the original padded leaf under 873/2000. The wire consumer checks INITIAL 1/0, the requested-unit shape and one-unit value, both SMS interfaces, and the absence of discharge and originator address using shared decoder limits.

Discharge alone and both wire orders of status plus discharge retain closure. Invalid requested-unit values produce their earlier 5004. Mixed unit shape, extra action and originator address retain their original earlier errors. TCP/TLS loopback under both explicit policies.
functionality_scope: Pure Go checkout; no persistence or external-target tests.
